meta.scope: research_only; existing calculator assumptions, no production change
meta.method: production fleet.parametric; isolated fleet.load; production seo.param_lease_usd

historical_display.unit: USD per month (nominal dollars of each year)
historical_display.fx_kind: fixed calibration convention from production type-page comparator, not live spot FX
historical_display.point_position: year + 0.5, annual display convention; not a source observation month
historical_display.meaning: A static current-model rent expressed in each year's nominal USD, not a historical prediction.
historical_display.currency_widget_note: The general research money widget uses a separate FX snapshot; charts stay in explicitly labelled USD.

plot_rules: Use raw_parametric_lease_eur_month for the independent model benchmark; never fit it to the plotted market observations.
Draw model references only on lease-rate charts. There is no production purchase-price model to draw on value charts.
Label every model reference with its type and age basis; a current-generation line is approximately age 12, not new.
For current-generation types, show the line as contextual only or use a separate aged panel; do not calculate a new-aircraft over/underpricing claim.
A user-selected market midpoint is an explicit calculator override, not an independent reference line.
Currency conversion and CPI normalization do not correct aircraft-age or contract-condition differences.
load_precedence: Explicit scenario/manual lease override; operator-specific before wildcard. A deliberately selected accepted market observation creates this override only when no manual lease is supplied.
A complete six-field fleet_economics bundle is selected operator-first, wildcard-second, retaining explicit overrides.
If no complete bundle exists: individual fleet_economics fields operator-first, wildcard-second.
Aircraft-card fleet_lease_eur_month if present and the higher layers lack a lease value.
Parametric generation/MTOW fallback. The age input affects TOiR maintenance, not this lease fallback.
meta.public_default_limit: This reproducible public source snapshot cannot establish operator, user or server-only overrides in a live calculation.
